name: Shinkirou
source:
The main character has slipped back in time to the Edo period. Choose one of the three Japanese-style boys and let's get to know each other!

Cautionary Note: 

• The gag elements account for about half of the story.
• The atmosphere of the story is Japanese style only, and is very different from the historical Edo period.
• There are some death scenes.
• Some characters may suddenly approach the screen.

If you are not good at the above, this game is not for you. Please be careful.

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/3018]Novelgame[/url]]
